name: Dr. Lev Sorensen
want: be the first person to confirm life on Mars
secret: Cultures from the deep ice core are showing activity he cannot explain as contamination. He has told no one and keeps the samples in an unlogged incubator.
voice: Soft-spoken, rambles when excited, deflects with jokes.
description: The station's doctor by duty and its biologist by love; happiest at a microscope, and a little harder to find every week.
appearance: Lanky and stooped, with an untidy blond beard, lab goggles around his neck and ink notes on the back of his hand.

agenda.goal: prove the deep-ice cultures are alive
steps: runs a second culture from the deep core in the unlogged incubator
checks the results against the contamination controls, twice

steps.text: comes to find Kit, wanting a second opinion from someone he trusts
